root_cause: PR #39796 modifies src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/graph_optimizer/prepare_primitive_fusing.cpp as part of restricting the quantize-into-eltwise fusion to the scale/shift form (fuse_primitives_with_layout fix), adding new guard clauses `if (const_pshape.is_dynamic()) continue;` (line 1694) and `if (!data_in_outer_dims) continue;` (line 1703) without braces around the single-statement bodies. The GPU clang-tidy CI job enables the readability-braces-around-statements check and treats clang-tidy warnings as errors (-Werror / CMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON), so the build fails at these two lines. This is the exact same recurring clang-tidy braces style violation this doctor has already recorded 5 times for other GPU-component PRs in prepare_primitive_fusing.cpp and related files over the past day (signature a4282c65071120e2), confirming it is a common, easily-avoided style mistake in that file rather than a flaky or infrastructure issue.
reproduction_steps: Build with clang-tidy enabled: cmake -DENABLE_CLANG_TIDY=ON ... && ninja openvino_intel_gpu_graph (or run clang-tidy-18 directly on src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/graph_optimizer/prepare_primitive_fusing.cpp with the readability-braces-around-statements check enabled and warnings-as-errors) to reproduce the two reported errors at lines 1694 and 1703.
recommended_actions: Add braces around the single-statement bodies of 'if (const_pshape.is_dynamic()) continue;' (line 1694) and 'if (!data_in_outer_dims) continue;' (line 1703) in src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/graph_optimizer/prepare_primitive_fusing.cpp
Run clang-tidy -fix locally on changed files in src/plugins/intel_gpu before pushing to catch this class of style violation earlier
Consider enabling the equivalent clang-format/clang-tidy braces check in local pre-commit hooks for GPU-plugin contributors
prevention_strategies: Enable a pre-commit or local clang-tidy check (matching the CI's enabled checks, including readability-braces-around-statements) for src/plugins/intel_gpu changes before pushing. This specific check and even this specific file (prepare_primitive_fusing.cpp) has now recurred 6 times across unrelated PRs; a lightweight CI pre-check, editor lint rule, or targeted reminder in the PR template for GPU-plugin changes would catch brace-less single-statement if/for/while bodies before CI.
historical_context: This exact failure signature (clang-tidy readability-braces-around-statements / Code Issue) has now been recorded 6 times, most recently today (2026-11-18) across PRs #39751, #39853, #38575, #38641, and now #39796, all touching GPU-plugin code and several in this exact file (prepare_primitive_fusing.cpp). This is a recurring, easily fixable style issue rather than an infrastructure problem.
